items.title: Microsoft Vs. Alphabet: How and Why They Stand Head-and-Shoulders Above Other Hyperscalers
items.summary: Azure just crossed a historic revenue milestone and Google Cloud is accelerating at a pace few predicted, yet both hyperscalers are spending so aggressively that only one of them still generates positive free cash flow. The gap between these two and every other cloud rival is widening fast, and the reasons why may reshape how investors think about AI infrastructure bets.
